newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 21.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker levels on Monday ended steady, traders said. There were active discussions but very little was transacted, a trader told Reuters. Small parcels lots of around 2,000 tonnes were heard traded at $121-$122 for 380-cst supplies, he said. "There are still adequate supplies in the market but sentiment is firm as bunker prices in Asia and Rotterdam remained strong," the trader said.
